prompt:
Design an American-traditional tattoo flash sheet on aged cream paper.

Nine designs arranged in a loose 3 x 3 layout with hand-placed spacing, each a self-contained tattoo: a swallow in flight, a dagger through a rose, a lighthouse with waves, a panther head, a ship's anchor with rope, a lit candle, a snake coiled around a heart, a compass rose, a single peony.

Style rules: bold black outlines of even weight, limited palette of red, golden yellow, forest green and black, solid fills with minimal shading, whip-shading only inside the black. Slight ink bleed and paper texture so it reads as a hand-painted sheet, not a vector file.

No banners with words, no lettering, no signature. Portrait orientation.
